description: One sparse hanging submerged vine anchored at the TOP edge with three slim stems flowing downward, small alternating pointed teal-green leaves and mint highlights, deep teal shadows. No pot and no wall. Isolated side-view 16-bit pixel art environment sprite for a cozy turquoise tiled underwater ruin. Crisp square pixel clusters, three or four shades per color, selective dark teal outline. Small decoration, restrained detail, readable silhouette. Entire plant including roots visible, at least four transparent pixels margin, except hanging anchor. No fish, no bubbles, no water, no scenery, no floor, no tile, no flowers, no gold, no text, no blur, no glow, no background. Single static sprite, not a sprite sheet.
